base_provider.relationship: Same pinned ALSA source and configure/time32 ABI, source-instrumented derivative; stock binary unchanged

build.command: python -B tools/audio_metrics_build.py --prepare; docker run --rm -v ROOT:/src pd2-alsa-native-builder sh /src/tools/audio_metrics_build.sh; python -B tools/audio_metrics_build.py --finalize
build.abi: ELF32 ARM hard-float; time_t=4; sync_ptr=132; ioctl=0xc0844123
build.reproducibility: Sources/options pinned; existing builder apt toolchain packages are not bit-reproducibly pinned

capture.transport: Inherited O_NONBLOCK write-only anonymous pipe; dedicated writer thread
capture.scope: Top-level public ALSA playback PCM APIs in processes loading this library; nested plugin calls suppressed; first 8 successful opens per process
caveats: Client-side negotiated PCM parameters, not necessarily hardware-slave parameters
EPIPE results and recover(-EPIPE) calls are observations, not unique underrun episodes
No audio samples, audible-quality verdict, or missing-data inference
Non-exec fork children disabled; exec loads initialize independently
Skipped try-lock updates/capacity tracked; abrupt termination can omit last snapshot
